name: Ready Pudding
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Make a batter of one quart of milk and about one pound of flour
Add six eggs, the yolks and whites separately beaten, a teaspoonful of salt and four tablespoonfuls of sugar
It should be as stiff as can possibly be stirred with a spoon
Dip a spoonful at a time into quick boiling water
Boil from five to ten minutes
Take out and serve hot with sauce or syrup

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Make a batter of one quart of milk and about one pound of flour
2. Add six eggs, the yolks and whites separately beaten, a teaspoonful of salt and four tablespoonfuls of sugar
3. It should be as stiff as can possibly be stirred with a spoon
4. Dip a spoonful at a time into quick boiling water
5. Boil from five to ten minutes
6. Take out and serve hot with sauce or syrup
